spec.headline: GTA 6 MADE |$3.79B| ON DAY ONE
spec.topic: GTA 6 day 3: Take-Two/Rockstar announced Fri 20 Nov 2026: $3.79B in sales and 32.5M copies through the end of launch day 19 Nov (pre-orders included). GTA V 2013 first 24 h: $815.7M / 11.21M (Take-Two). 3.79/0.8157 = 4.6x (our math). Sources: CNN Business (20 Nov), TweakTown (20 Nov), GameSpot headline
